tool.name: AMRfior
tool.description: AMR gene detection with built-in CARD/ResFinder/NCBI databases
tool.command:
mkdir -p output_dir &&
#if 'user-provided' in $databases and str($user_db_path): mkdir -p user_db_dir/diamond user_db_dir/blast_dna user_db_dir/blast_aa user_db_dir/bowtie2 user_db_dir/bwa user_db_dir/minimap2 && diamond makedb --in '$user_db_aa' --db user_db_dir/diamond/all_aa_diamonddb.dmnd --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} && makeblastdb -in '$user_db_dna' -dbtype nucl -out user_db_dir/blast_dna/all_blastdb -parse_seqids && makeblastdb -in '$user_db_aa' -dbtype prot -out user_db_dir/blast_aa/all_aa_blastdb -parse_seqids && bowtie2-build --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} '$user_db_dna' user_db_dir/bowtie2/all_bowtie2db && bwa index -p user_db_dir/bwa/all_bwadb '$user_db_dna' && minimap2 -d user_db_dir/minimap2/all_minimap2db '$user_db_dna' && #end if
#if $sequence_type == 'Paired-FASTQ': #set $input_str = $input + ',' + $input_r2 #else: #set $input_str = $input #end if
AMRfior -i '$input_str' -st '$sequence_type' -o output_dir -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4}
#if $tools: --tools #echo ' '.join($tools)# #end if
--databases #echo ' '.join($databases)#
#if 'user-provided' in $databases and str($user_db_path): --user-db-path user_db_dir #end if
#if str($sec_thresholds.report_fasta): --report-fasta '$sec_thresholds.report_fasta' #end if
#if $sequence_type == 'Genes-FASTA': --genes-type '$genes_type' #end if
--q-min-cov $sec_thresholds.q_min_cov --q-min-id $sec_thresholds.q_min_id --d-min-cov $sec_thresholds.d_min_cov --d-min-id $sec_thresholds.d_min_id --d-min-depth $sec_thresholds.d_min_depth --d-min-reads $sec_thresholds.d_min_reads --detection-system '$sec_thresholds.detection_system'
#if $sec_advanced.mode == 'dna-only': --dna-only #elif $sec_advanced.mode == 'protein-only': --protein-only #end if
#if str($sec_advanced.sensitivity) != 'default': --sensitivity '$sec_advanced.sensitivity' #end if
--minimap2-preset '$sec_advanced.minimap2_preset' --blastx-task '$sec_advanced.blastx_task'
#if str($sec_advanced.evalue): -e $sec_advanced.evalue #end if
#if $sec_advanced.fastp_trim and $sequence_type == 'Paired-FASTQ': --fastp-trim #end if
#for $tp in $sec_advanced.tool_param: --tool-param '$tp.tool_name=$tp.params' #end for
$sec_advanced.verbose
&& cd output_dir && det=\$(find . -name '*_detection_matrix.tsv' ! -name '*combined*' | head -1) && if [ -n "\$det" ]; then mv "\$det" '$detection_matrix'; fi && evi=\$(find . -name '*_evidence_matrix.tsv' ! -name '*combined*' | head -1) && if [ -n "\$evi" ]; then mv "\$evi" '$evidence_matrix'; fi && evs=\$(find . -name '*_evidence_summary.tsv' | head -1) && if [ -n "\$evs" ]; then mv "\$evs" '$evidence_summary'; fi && all=\$(find . -name '*_allele_resolution.tsv' | head -1) && if [ -n "\$all" ]; then mv "\$all" '$allele_resolution'; fi #if str($sec_thresholds.report_fasta): && rep=\$(find . -name '*_report.fasta' | head -1) && if [ -n "\$rep" ]; then mv "\$rep" '$report_fasta'; fi #end if && cd .. && tar -czf '$results_archive' output_dir

param.name: input
param.label: Input sequences
param.help: FASTA or FASTQ file (.gz accepted). For Paired-FASTQ, provide R1 here

param.name: input_r2
param.label: R2 mate (Paired-FASTQ only)
param.help: Second read file for paired-end FASTQ input

param.name: sequence_type
param.label: Sequence type
param.help: Specify the input type: Single-FASTA, Paired-FASTQ, or Genes-FASTA

param.name: genes_type
param.label: Genes type (Genes-FASTA only)
param.help: Required when sequence type is Genes-FASTA: DNA or amino-acid sequences

param.name: databases
param.label: AMR databases
param.help: Select which pre-packaged AMR databases to use. CARD and ResFinder are used by default. The NCBI AMR database is also available. Select 'user-provided' to supply custom databases

param.name: user_db_path
param.label: User-provided database path
param.help: Required when 'user-provided' is selected. Path to a database directory built with build_database.sh

param.name: user_db_dna
param.label: User-provided DB DNA FASTA
param.help: DNA sequences for the user-provided database (when 'user-provided' is selected)

param.name: user_db_aa
param.label: User-provided DB AA FASTA
param.help: Amino acid sequences for the user-provided database (when 'user-provided' is selected)

tool.help:
@GENEFIOR_HELP@
**AMRfior** — AMR gene detection with built-in databases
This tool runs the GeneFíor pipeline with pre-packaged AMR databases installed via bioconda. The available databases are:
- **ResFinder** — Antimicrobial resistance genes (selected by default) - **CARD** — Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database (selected by default) - **NCBI AMR** — NCBI's AMR reference gene database - **User-provided** — Custom database (built from provided DNA and AA FASTA files)
No `--db-path` is required when using the built-in databases. The CARD, ResFinder, and NCBI databases are installed as part of the bioconda package and are automatically discovered at runtime.
**Outputs:**
- **Detection matrix** — Binary presence/absence per gene and tool - **Evidence matrix** — Qualified per-tool evidence statuses - **Evidence summary** — Evidence, candidate-allele, and exact-allele counts - **Allele resolution** — Family-level top candidate and competing alleles - **Report FASTA** *(optional)* — Sequences passing detection thresholds - **Results archive** — Full output directory (tar.gz), usable as input to Recompute, Gene-Stats, or Combine
